title: Chemical Reactor Internals & Agitators
description: Shaft with impeller blades, support baffles, dip tubes, spargers — often as welded assemblies
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 12 (Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni) offers superior corrosion resistance in reducing acid environments at lower cost than Grade 7. High strength and good weldability.
Form: Plate and tube construction is standard for agitator assemblies. Shaft uses bar or tube depending on torque requirements.
engineeringTrends: Process: CNC profiling of impeller blades
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B265 Grade 12 plate, stress-relieved, 100% weld inspection (PT/UT), material cert 3.1, vacuum heat treated per AMS 2750
